title: yoke-global receipt outside a project is not yet proved on a released build
text: yoke-global picks or adds the project, carries the user's request and names the folder where a new session runs /yoke onboard, and outside-project orientation names it as the next action. Setup installs it in ~/.agents/skills/yoke-global with a Claude link, and the machine-wide hooks deliver that orientation outside a project. A premerge candidate walk proved receipt and discovery on claude-cli, codex-cli and cursor-cli; this stays open until a released build proves the same on hosted and self-hosted installs.
